text:
maria: Idea: 'Compact pin view' - a minimal dashboard mode that pins a model filter inside a route view and surfaces only model-level metrics + sampled traces. Good for noisy multi-model routes. Thoughts? :bulb:

sam: Nice. UX q: do we show any routing fallback info? If not people will misread it as single-model traffic.

tj: Also need an immediate cost peek. If the pinned model is large we should show estimated token burn for the view up front.

maria: Plan: reuse the cost-preview calc but scoped to pinned filters + sampling multiplier. Small badge in the header (eg 'est. burn: $X/day') with tooltip explaining assumptions.

lisa: Telemetry: add event fields `compact_pin=1`, `pinned_model_id`, `view_sample_rate`. Also bump trace sampling when users open the compact view (maybe 2x) but that requires a per-org cap.

cheng: API implications: saved_query needs new keys but keep proto flat. Proposing fields like `view_mode=compact_pin`, `pinned_models=redwood-rlhf-v3`, `sample_override=2x` as strings to avoid schema churn.

oliver: ACL/sharing: shared saved queries can leak internal variant ids. For org-public queries we should redact variant suffixes or map to safe display names. Also add an owner-only flag `expose_variant` to gate it.

sam: Rollout idea: behind a feature flag, 5% canary for 2 weeks. Capture confusion signals: help clicks, fallback-summary opens, and support tickets.

maria: I'll add to rollout checklist. @deploy-bot can you create experiment `compact-pin-canary` start 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC, 2w at 5%?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created experiment compact-pin-canary; id exp-4210; start 2026-04-12 08:00 UTC; rollout 5%. :robot_face:

lisa: Ops note: auto-increasing trace sampling raises ingest cost. We need a per-org sampling_budget + enforcement ceiling. Also surface projected ingest delta in the cost peek.

cheng: I'll draft a minimal saved_query proto change and open PR `savedquery/compact-pin-mode`. Will include validation to block shared queries exposing raw variant ids.

maria: Next steps: cheng PR, lisa budget proposal, oliver ACL pattern, sam canary plan. Report back here when PRs or designs are up. :thumbsup:
